stories.title: Datafolha: 25% dos eleitores de Flávio Bolsonaro dizem escolher candidato para derrotar Lula

en.title: Datafolha: 25% of Flávio Bolsonaro voters say they chose candidate to defeat Lula
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows that 25% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters selected him primarily to defeat President Lula, while 13% of Lula voters chose him to defeat the senator.

stories.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro é rejeitado por 43% e Lula, por 46%

en.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro rejected by 43% and Lula by 46%
en.summary: The first Datafolha poll of the presidential runoff shows high rejection rates for both candidates, with 46% unwilling to vote for Lula and 43% rejecting Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Pesquisa Datafolha: Flávio tem 49% e Lula soma 45% no segundo turno

en.title: Datafolha poll: Flávio has 49% and Lula totals 45% in runoff
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 49% of voting intentions against 45% for Lula in the presidential runoff.

en.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro, 49%; Lula, 45%
en.summary: The first Datafolha poll of the runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro at 49% and Lula at 45%, with the institute noting a technical tie within the two-point margin of error.

stories.title: Augusto Cury declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno

en.title: Augusto Cury declares support for Flávio Bolsonaro in runoff
en.summary: Former presidential candidate Augusto Cury announced his support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff against incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Cury stated he would maintain his political independence and not participate in Bolsonaro's government.

stories.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 52% e Lula, 48% em votos válidos no 2º turno

en.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro has 52% and Lula 48% in valid votes in runoff
en.summary: A Datafolha poll conducted after the presidential runoff was set shows senator Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 52 percent of valid votes compared to incumbent president Lula with 48 percent.

stories.title: Datafolha: Celina tem 55% de intenção de votos no segundo turno no DF; Grass, 37%

en.title: Datafolha: Celina has 55% voting intention in runoff in DF; Grass 37%
en.summary: A Datafolha survey indicates Celina leads with 55 percent voting intention in a District Federal runoff, while Grass receives 37 percent.

stories.title: Cury acerta apoio à candidatura de Flávio no segundo turno

en.title: Cury secures support for Flávio's runoff candidacy
en.summary: Writer Augusto Cury, who finished third in the election, finalized his endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro for the presidential runoff. The announcement was expected during Bolsonaro's weekly livestream.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha do segundo turno: veja números de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: New Datafolha poll for second round: see numbers for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: Datafolha released a new poll on the 2026 presidential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with a two-percentage-point margin of error.

stories.title: Pesquisa Lula e Flávio no segundo turno: o que diz Datafolha em levantamento

en.title: Lula and Flávio poll in second round: what Datafolha says in survey
en.summary: A new Datafolha poll presents the scenario for the 2026 presidential runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula.

stories.title: Datafolha 2º turno: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 49% e Lula, 45% das intenções de voto

en.title: Datafolha second round: Flávio Bolsonaro has 49% and Lula 45% of voting intentions
en.summary: A Datafolha poll for the 2026 presidential runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro with 49% of voting intentions against Lula's 45%.

stories.title: Flávio lidera 2º turno com 49% das intenções de voto contra 45% de Lula, diz Datafolha

en.title: Flávio leads second round with 49% of voting intentions against Lula's 45%, says Datafolha
en.summary: A Datafolha poll released Thursday shows senator Flávio Bolsonaro leading the 2026 presidential runoff with 49% of voting intentions over Lula's 45%.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest no Rio Grande do Norte para segundo turno mede disputa acirrada entre Allyson e Cadu de Lula

en.title: New Quaest survey in Rio Grande do Norte for runoff measures tight dispute between Allyson and Cadu de Lula
en.summary: A Quaest poll will measure voting intentions for state governor and president in Rio Grande do Norte's 2026 runoff election. The survey of 1,098 voters will be released Tuesday, with fieldwork conducted from Friday to Monday.

stories.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 49% das intenções de voto e Lula, 45%, no segundo turno

en.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro has 49% of voting intentions and Lula, 45%, in the runoff
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows senator Flávio Bolsonaro with 49% of voting intentions and president Lula with 45% in a runoff scenario. The candidates are technically tied within the margin of error, with 5% planning to vote blank or null.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest no Amazonas para segundo turno mede duelo entre Omar Aziz e Professora Maria do Carmo

en.title: New Quaest survey in Amazonas for runoff measures duel between Omar Aziz and Professor Maria do Carmo
en.summary: A Quaest poll will measure voting intentions for state governor and president in Amazonas's 2026 runoff election. The survey of 1,098 voters will be released Tuesday, testing whether Omar Aziz's wide lead persists into the second round.

stories.title: Fux pede acesso a inquéritos contra Bolsonaro relatados por Alexandre de Moraes

en.title: Fux requests access to inquiries against Bolsonaro reported by Alexandre de Moraes
en.summary: Minister Luiz Fux ordered the Supreme Court's technical staff to grant his office access to confidential inquiries handled by Alexandre de Moraes involving Bolsonaro and allies. The inquiries cover fake news, digital militias, coup plots, and vaccine card forgery.

stories.title: Datafolha: No DF, Celina Leão tem 55% dos votos e Leandro Grass, 37%, no segundo turno

en.title: Datafolha: In the Federal District, Celina Leão has 55% of votes and Leandro Grass, 37%, in runoff
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows incumbent Federal District governor Celina Leão with 55% voter support against Leandro Grass at 37% in a runoff election scheduled for October 25, with 3% undecided voters.
